facts: About 506,000 people (2020), the second most populous city in Scotland
Between the Firth of Forth and the Pentland Hills
worth_knowing: The Fringe, held here every year, is the world's largest annual international arts festival. Edinburgh has been recognised as the capital of Scotland since at least the 15th century.
